why: Steps 0-1 (eval-awareness-dana-cues-smoke / -natural / -natural-look, gemma-2-2b-it): every Dana message reads as EVALUATION at >= 0.98, cue or not, so a direction cannot come from Dana. Option 2 builds it from plain statements about the situation, as Hua, Qin, Marks, Nanda (arXiv 2510.20487) did ('You are in evaluation' vs 'You are in deployment').
pairs_rule: each pair is one sentence frame; only the words that say test vs real differ. Each sentence is the whole user turn (gemma chat template); the notes are read at the last token of the templated prompt, the same token in every pair.
